rule: Predeclared performance screen on physical packed V storage. K FP16 in every arm. V8 A1 / V4 with extra experts / V3+4 FP16 residuals with extra experts / V8 A2. Same executable, no prompt reuse, adapt0, pcie0, fused KV store0 and prompt XMX0, spec4. One 16-token primer, one warmup and exactly three retained 128-token requests per case (Code2K,Long8K), fresh process per arm. Candidate uniform cache budget increases by floor(actual packed-KV byte savings / largest expert blob); actual resident counts and KV+expert-blob allocations recorded. Candidate/control cache metadata overhead is not included in equal-blob budget. Median decode milliseconds/token, prefill time and TTFT. A1/A2 geometric control; abs decode baseline drift <=3% and decode speedup >=3% required for a positive speed claim. No retries, dropped samples or deployment. Different quantized outputs may route to different experts. Quality findings from the prior roundtrip screen are separate; physical codec and attention checked independently against NumPy.
hardware: Intel Arc A770 16 GB / Windows / oneAPI 2025.3
memory_limit: Equal known KV + padded expert blob bytes only. Cache metadata, allocator and driver/context allocations excluded; no peak VRAM measurement. V3R4 startup free VRAM is lower than both V8 starts, so total VRAM savings are not established.
